description: Signal-rich ZH simulation with H to ZZ to four leptons, reduced for a visual masterclass. It stores selected leptons, their combinations, and all possible ZZ pairing choices. It is intended for reconstruction and combinatorial-selection studies, not a physical background or significance measurement.

Events.title: Events
Events.description: One row per event. Useful for best-candidate plots and event-level counts.

Leptons.title: Single leptons
Leptons.description: One row per selected electron or muon.

Dileptons.title: Two-lepton combinations
Dileptons.description: Every possible pair of selected leptons in an event.

QuadLeptons.title: Four-lepton combinations
QuadLeptons.description: Every possible group of four selected leptons in an event.

PairingOptions.title: ZZ pairing options
PairingOptions.description: The three ways to split a four-lepton group into two pairs.

pt.label: transverse momentum
pt.tooltip: Sideways momentum, measured perpendicular to the beam.

phi.label: phi
phi.tooltip: Azimuthal angle around the beam pipe.

energy.label: energy
energy.tooltip: Total energy of the object or combination.

scalar_pt_sum.label: sum of lepton pT
scalar_pt_sum.tooltip: Add the individual lepton pT values. A useful comparison, but not mass.

mass.label: combined mass
mass.tooltip: The mass obtained after accounting for both energy and momentum.

energy_minus_momentum.label: energy minus momentum
energy_minus_momentum.tooltip: A simple attempt at removing motion from energy. It is not quite the invariant mass.

dr.label: angular separation ΔR
dr.tooltip: How far apart two leptons are in detector angle space.

opening_angle.label: 3D opening angle
opening_angle.tooltip: The angle between two leptons in three dimensions.

charge_sum.label: charge sum
charge_sum.tooltip: Total electric charge of the combination.

is_os.label: opposite charge
is_os.tooltip: 1 means the two leptons have opposite electric charge.

is_sf.label: same flavor
is_sf.tooltip: 1 means the two leptons are both electrons or both muons.

is_ossf.label: opposite-charge same-flavor
is_ossf.tooltip: Often useful when studying Z-boson decays.

best_m4l.label: best four-lepton mass
best_m4l.tooltip: Four-lepton mass for the best ZZ-like candidate in the event.

z1_mass.label: Z1 candidate mass
z1_mass.tooltip: Mass of the pair closer to the known Z mass within a four-lepton candidate.

z2_mass.label: Z2 candidate mass
z2_mass.tooltip: Mass of the other pair in the ZZ candidate.

score_looks_like_ZZ.label: ZZ-like score
score_looks_like_ZZ.tooltip: A stored comparison quantity for teacher or technical views.

pair_a_mass.label: pair A mass
pair_a_mass.tooltip: Mass of one pair in a proposed split of four leptons.

pair_b_mass.label: pair B mass
pair_b_mass.tooltip: Mass of the other pair in a proposed split of four leptons.
